═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
TRADE WATCHDOG — WARNING   (23:49 UTC)
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════

Open Trades: 4 (4 long, 0 short)
Unrealized PnL: +0.46 USDT  (HYPE +1.11%, BTC +0.78%, HYPER +0.61%, ENS +0.03%)
Regime: regime_5m aggregate LONG_BIAS (79L/1S/48N of 128) | regimes.BTC LONG_BIAS 56.1 | btc_4h SHORT_BIAS | continuum ABOVE EMA300 gap +327 | Vol NORMAL
Flips/24h: agg 16, BTC 17 — inside band (p50 19, p95 26), standing churn, not an anomaly

── Steers ──────────────────────────────────────
🔴 [profit_lock] HYPE #16383 — manual SL 75.788 → 75.958 (breakeven). Condition re-tested 23:49: price 76.80 ≥ 75.958, +1.11% headroom. No automated path exists: hl_copy_trader ∈ PROFIT_MONSTER_BYPASS_SIGNALS (profit_monster log 23:45 = "Found 2 open positions" = BTC + ENS only), ATR engine floor is entry×~0.9977 = 75.788 (−0.22%). This is the book's best performer with its weakest protection. age=5 cycles unexecuted.
🟡 [regime] Hold all 4 LONGs only while BTC 1m closes stay above EMA300; exit = 3 consecutive 1m closes below. Re-tested 23:44:52 → price 80841.5 vs EMA300 80514.8, gap +327, consecutive_below 0, 667 bars above. Condition HOLDS. RETRACTED — prior cycle's "gap narrowing 171→131, first touch ~60 min out" projection: reversed by the 23:35-23:44 rally, gap re-widened +131 → +327. The exit line stands; the countdown does not. age=5 cycles unexecuted.
🟡 [cluster] 4/4 one-way long book with asymmetric protection. BTC and ENS route to profit_monster (14d 78T/71W, 91.0%, +5.11). HYPE and HYPER are structurally excluded from it and capped at −0.22% / −0.26%. One EMA300 break exits the protected pair at +0.53% / on ATR, the unprotected pair at full risk.
🟡 [health] HYPER #16387 thesis fading — re-test before it bleeds. Entered LONG at meta_rsi 55.56, dead centre of the 45-60 death band (7d 44T/17W 38.6%/−1.36) on pump-chain+ (7d 14T/2W/−0.88, worst family of the week); 1m RSI has since rolled to 40.6 with 30m −0.15%, price 0.0649 vs floor 0.06434. Condition-keyed: manual exit or BE at 0.064509 if 1m RSI holds <45 for 15m while price <0.0648 — re-tested at write: RSI 40.6 (<45), price 0.0649 (≥0.0648), so NOT yet triggered.
🟢 [info] BTC #16385 PM trail ACTIVE — activated 23:09 at +0.40%, peak_pnl now 0.7267%, floor ≈ peak −0.20 = +0.53% ≈ 80715. First real ratchet in the book and the only one.
🟢 [opportunity] Prior cycle's NIL/GRASS/YGG watch all re-tested and gate-blocked: GRASS LONG RSI 79.9 > 75 ceiling (FAIL), NIL has no fresh 1m data (price_age 139990 min) so precheck cannot compute RSI (FAIL), YGG 1m RSI 24.0 sits at the <35 bucket edge. None capturable regardless — AI_TRADER_ENABLED=False.
🟢 [pick] CHIP LONG conf 76 — WATCHLIST ONLY (AI_TRADER_ENABLED=False, will NOT execute). Prior ZORA pick superseded: its rsi_at_pick 33.0 has drifted to 48.4 (Δ15.4 > AI_TRADER_RSI_DRIFT_MAX 15), it would now be rejected.

── Deep Analysis ───────────────────────────────
The book is on the right side and the tape just got stronger — but the two trades carrying the most unrealized profit are the two with no profit lock, which is exactly backwards.

**Regime / alignment.** BTC 1m has now held above EMA300 for 667 consecutive bars and the gap re-widened from +131 to +327 in thirty minutes on a genuine 23:35-23:44 push (80561 → 80896). regime_5m aggregate is the most one-sided of the night: 79 long / 1 short / 48 neutral of 128 tokens, and all four open coins read LONG_BIAS individually (ENS 83.2, HYPER 85.3, HYPE 56.1, BTC 56.1). Short-horizon sources agree; the 4h (SHORT_BIAS) and auto_trader (CHOP, score_long 25 / score_short −45, MANAGE_ONLY on 6/6 recent decisions) do not. Direction-flavored steers above are therefore condition-keyed, not bias-keyed, and every one of them re-tests the condition at write time. Flip rate 16/17 per 24h sits inside the calibrated band — this is the standing high-churn state, not a signal.

**Protection asymmetry is the real exposure.** Four longs, and the mechanical exits sort like this: BTC PM trail ratchets into profit (floor +0.53%); ENS is bb-squeeze+, not in PROFIT_MONSTER_BYPASS_SIGNALS, so profit_monster counts it (the 2-position log since 23:37 is BTC + ENS) and will manage it once armed; HYPE (hl_copy_trader) and HYPER (pump-chain+) are both in the bypass list, so the only exits they have are their ATR stops at −0.22% and −0.26%, or target. Measured from PostgreSQL this cycle over 14 days: profit-monster-trail exits are 78T / 71W / **91.0% WR / +5.11**, atr_trail_hit 26T / 20W / +4.13, versus hard_max_loss 69T / 0W / **−6.66** with only 1 of 69 ever reaching +0.40% MFE. We are holding the week's best performer (HYPE +1.11%, 62% of the way to its 77.24 target) on the side of the book that structurally cannot lock. That is a one-line manual fix, not a design problem.

**Entry quality splits 3-for-1.** Re-verified on meta_rsi this cycle: BTC 5.48 and HYPE 26.79 are both in the LONG <35 winning bucket (4T/3W/+0.17), ENS 66.67 is in LONG 60+ (18T/9W/+0.39) and rides bb-squeeze+ (5T/3W/+0.30, a winning family). HYPER 55.56 is the odd one out — dead centre of LONG 45-60, 7d 44T/17W 38.6% / −1.36, the single largest loss bucket in the system, on pump-chain+ (14T/2W/−0.88). It is working (+0.61%) but its own 1m RSI has already rolled 55.56 → 40.6 while the rest of the book's momentum went the other way (BTC 1m RSI 81.5, HYPE 69.6, ENS 80.0). One trade in the book is diverging from the tape it was bought into.

**Wrong-side accounting, last 24h: 8 closed / 5W / +0.39.** All three losers are directional-side errors, not timing errors — which is the whole thesis of this role:
- **CHIP −1.63% SHORT @63.01** — trailed out while the coin kept rising. The winning side was LONG: CHIP now reads LONG_BIAS conf **93.1**, the highest confidence of all 128 scanned tokens, +3.08% over 16×5m, 1m RSI 71.8. Someone was long what we were short and took our 1.63%.
- **BTC #16377 −3.42% SHORT** — BTC never closed below EMA300 during the whole 46-minute window; it has not closed below since. The winning side was LONG, on the exact level that now governs all four open trades.
- **HBAR −0.49% LONG @56.52, trail_arm_timeout** — never reached the +0.40% arm (MFE +0.10%), i.e. no room to trend. bb-bounce-v2-long+ is 18T/8W/−0.59 for the week.
No repeat-failure streak. But two of the three are the same error — shorting into an uptape — and we are now 4/4 long, so the mirror risk is a long into a downtape, which is what the single re-testable EMA300 exit line exists to catch.

**Correlation / opportunity cost.** Four of six slots, zero hedge, one factor: if BTC dumps, all four go together — there is no diversifying leg. The answer is not a short (the 5m tape is 79L/1S and shorting it is how we lost BTC #16377), it is the exit condition plus not adding a fifth correlated long until the first EMA300 test resolves. Hot coins are not being missed: GRASS, NIL and YGG all fail precheck gates on re-test, and AI_TRADER_ENABLED=False makes the question moot for execution.

── Recommendations ─────────────────────────────
1. Ratchet HYPE → 75.958 (breakeven) now. Best performer in the book, zero lock, age=5 cycles, nothing automated will do it.
2. Keep exactly one exit line across all four: 3 consecutive 1m closes below EMA300. Re-tested — gap +327, consecutive_below 0. The prior narrowing countdown is retracted; the line is not.
3. HYPER: watch the condition (1m RSI <45 for 15m while price <0.0648). Not yet triggered at write. If it triggers, exit or move to BE 0.064509 — it is the only open trade sitting in a losing RSI bucket on the week's worst family.
4. No 5th long while the book is 4/4 one-way; re-evaluate after the first EMA300 test resolves or a slot frees.
5. CHIP LONG written as watchlist only — AI_TRADER_ENABLED=False, it will NOT execute. If the flag flips, it fires only while BTC 1m still holds above EMA300 and fire-time RSI ≤75 / within 15 pts of 71.8.

- regimes.BTC (15m): LONG_BIAS conf 56.1 (prior cycle: NEUTRAL). watchdog btc_15m: LONG_BIAS. watchdog btc_4h: SHORT_BIAS. Sources still disagree across horizons.
- continuum (1m, 23:44:52): price 80841.5 ABOVE EMA300 80514.8 (+327), consecutive_below 0, 667 consecutive bars above, last cross 1792865460, linreg_1m_slope +0.0054, zscore 2.26 (STRONG_POS), velocity −0.034, acceleration −0.127 (NEGATIVE), volume_ratio 0.078 (LOW), trend_quality STRONG_UP, wyckoff MARKUP.
- auto_trader: regime CHOP on all 6 recent decisions, score_long 25 / score_short −45, MANAGE_ONLY, shadow armed [].
- Signal-analyst macro gate: LONG=FULL, SHORT=REDUCE (regime=LONG_BIAS, wr=60%); shorts actively blocked by CONTINUUM-BULL / SHORT-CONTINUUM hysteresis.
Flip-rate KPI (mandatory): aggregate **16** flips/24h, BTC 15m **17** flips/24h — inside the calibrated band (full-log p50=19, p95=26; last-14d min 11), i.e. the standing high-churn state, NOT an anomaly. The old ">=6 = high churn" line is satisfied on essentially every dump and cannot distinguish anything. Unusually unstable would be >=26 (p95). The informative tail is <6 = a real trend tape, which has not occurred since Oct 2 — so snapshot-directional prose is not cheap right now: every directional steer above is condition-keyed and re-tested next cycle, with retraction required if the condition reverses.
Trend watch — CORRECTION: prior cycle projected "gap 171->131, first touch of EMA300 within ~60 min". That projection is RETRACTED. BTC pushed 80561 -> 80896 over 23:35-23:44 and the gap re-widened to +327. The governing variable is no longer approaching; it moved away. Re-read the gap from continuum_data.json every cycle rather than carrying a rate forward.
Position fit: portfolio 4/4 LONG, aligned with the 5m aggregate, the 1m continuum and regimes.BTC; misaligned with btc_4h SHORT_BIAS and the auto_trader CHOP view. Two of four (HYPE, HYPER) have no profit lock, so alignment plus the exit line is doing all the work — which is why the exit must stay a single re-testable condition (3 consecutive 1m closes below EMA300) rather than a bias read.
